notes.99000001: Designed near-miss. Reports IC50 values, so numeric_endpoint is met, but the model is HEK293 stably transfected with OATP1B1. The liver_model criterion says transfected non-liver lines such as HEK293 do NOT qualify, so this is an exclusion on liver_model. The abstract is deliberately dense with the words hepatic, pravastatin and uptake, so a screen weighting vocabulary over the stated model includes it.
notes.99000002: Designed near-miss. Cryopreserved primary human hepatocytes with IC50 values from six donors. The liver_model criterion says immortalised lines and primary cells both qualify, so this is an inclusion. A screen matching only HepG2, Huh7 or HepaRG misses it. This is the mirror of 99000001: the same criterion decides both, in opposite directions.
notes.99000003: Designed flag. IC50 values are reported, so numeric_endpoint is met, but the abstract names no cell model and defers the method to an earlier paper. liver_model cannot be evaluated from the text provided. on_ambiguity is flag, so the correct answer is flag at low confidence rather than an exclusion inferred from absence. Unevaluable is not the same as false.
notes.99000004: Designed flag. A single sentence. Neither include criterion can be evaluated and neither exclusion can be ruled out. Deliberately far shorter than the rest of the corpus, because being too short to screen is the property under test.
notes.99000012: Designed near-miss, the reverse of 99000003. A genuine liver model, HepG2, with a drug treatment, but the endpoint is reported only as significantly reduced viability with no number. numeric_endpoint is evaluable here and evaluates to false, so this excludes rather than flags. The contrast with 99000003 is the point: there the criterion could not be judged, here it can be judged and fails.
notes.99000013: Designed near-miss on the definition of drug. HepG2 with an IC50, so numeric_endpoint and liver_model are both met, but the treatment is a crude ethanolic seed extract, unfractionated, with no constituent isolated or quantified. The no_drug clause says crude or unfractionated extracts do NOT qualify, so exclude_if_any fires and this excludes. Paired with 99000061, which is the same species and the same cell line and includes, because there the active constituent is named and quantified. The pair differs in exactly one property, which is the property the clause turns on.
notes.99000061: Designed near-miss, the counterpart to 99000013. A Silybum marianum extract standardised to 78.4 per cent silibinin by weight, quantified by liquid chromatography against a reference standard and dosed as silibinin equivalents at stated micromolar concentrations, in HepG2, with an IC50 of 96 micromolar. The no_drug clause admits a standardised extract only if its active constituent is named and quantified, and here it is both, so no_drug does not fire and the record includes. Under the earlier wording of the clause this record had no answer at all: it is in the corpus to prove the revised clause gives it one.
